[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Distinct Numbers** [CSES 1621 · Distinct Numbers](https://cses.fi/problemset/task/1621)

"Distinct" is the hash set's reason to exist: insert everything, read the size. The sorting alternative exists too, and is worth knowing because it is the guaranteed version and generalises to "sorted distinct list".

[Solved in full in @sec-hash-p3-a.]{.card-link}
